## Frequently asked questions

### How many guests can Vista Hall hold?
Radiance Hall and Reflection Hall seat 200 guests each, and the Sky Lounge takes 60–80.

### Where is Vista Hall?
Plot No. 69, Ground Floor, Gomathy Nagar Velachery, Vijayanagar, N Extension Main Rd, Madipakkam, Chennai 600 091.

### What facilities does Vista Hall have?
Fully air-conditioned, Sound & lighting, Weddings & receptions, Birthday parties, Corporate events & conferences, Baby showers, Sangeet & mehendi, Open 6 AM – 11 PM, all week.

### What are the opening hours?
6 AM to 11 PM, seven days a week.

### How do I check if Vista Hall is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 97890 53535.
